feature_protocol.name: overlap_contact
feature_protocol.layout: role_contact dimensions; packet result replaces tile cohesion
feature_protocol.scales: fixed observation transforms only, not hardware calibration or physical limits
feature_protocol.workload: fixed 1024 px windows and 824 px stride; profile-derived bytes/work/results

scenario_distribution.scope: continuous training randomization; disjoint orbital time blocks

minibatch_estimator: For B uniformly shuffled rows among R: L_hat = R/(E*B) sum_batch_valid_labels CE/N_episode
normalization: N_e counts valid tile labels; no per-batch sum-of-weights normalization; final short batch uses its actual B
shuffle: CPU generator receives RNG state after the same seeded model construction; deterministic teacher collection consumes no torch RNG
scope: independent BC treatment; no PPO, validation or test evaluation in this script
